assets.imagegen_prompt:
Use case: background-extraction
Asset type: production game UI button sprite
Image 1 is the approved full interface. Image 2 identifies the target only; surrounding pixels must be removed.
Regenerate only the round pink close button at the upper-right of the popup, near source coordinates (756,524). Include its thick white rounded X-shaped close pictogram as an integral graphical icon. Match the reference: circular candy-pink glossy face, pale cream double rim, warm peach thin outer edge, delicate soft pink local shadow, plump rounded white diagonal bars with a fine pink outline. Front-facing circle, not a tilted disk. Remove the ribbon, panel, rabbit and every neighboring object. Keep the entire circle and local shadow. Do not replace the X with a font glyph or thin lines.
One complete isolated asset only, centered with 8 percent padding. PERFECTLY FLAT PURE GREEN #00FF00 backdrop for chroma keying, no green reflections or spill. No checkerboard, no floor, no scene, no watermark. No words or numbers. Do not render the complete interface or an asset sheet.
assets.alpha_processing: native alpha preserved or bundled chroma removal with soft matte and despill
